name: Keyboard Shortcut Recorder
description: A focused shortcut recorder with engraved keycaps, modifier validation, cancellation and reset, designed for desktop-style app preferences.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled sequence of KeyboardEvent modifier names followed by the final key. Without onChange, recording and reset are read-only.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial and reset sequence. Local initialization and notifications copy the array.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Synchronous notification containing a separate chord array. The host acknowledges controlled changes, registers shortcuts, resolves collisions and handles unsupported OS combinations.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.
